command: node --test (234 tests, of which 9 in test/client.test.js run the shipped client.js in a vm against a stand-in for React and a stub host); six mutations of client.js, each restored

checks.name: The panel offers claim, checkpoint and end and refuses bad input before sending it
checks.details: While the conversation's AWR session is active the panel shows 'Manage this session'. Claim runs /awr claim and is shown only when the session holds no claim and the bound work is neither completed nor closed. Save a checkpoint runs /awr checkpoint DIGEST :: NEXT from two required fields, collapses whitespace and newlines to single spaces, and refuses an empty field or one holding '::' before anything is sent (six input pairs tested, zero commands sent). End the session asks first, notes that ending a session does not complete its work, and sends one of three outcomes whatever the select holds (a value 'ended; rm -rf /' is sent as 'ended'). A refusal from the host is shown in red without a retry or a refresh; the buttons are disabled while a command runs so a double click sends one command; the actions disappear when the session is not active. Limits: run in a vm against a stand-in for React and a stub host, not inside DeepSeek Harness; one project per panel.
criteria: The panel offers claim, checkpoint and end for an active AWR session, each running the /awr command of the same name, and refuses bad input before sending it.

checks.name: The behavior is covered by tests that fail when the checks are removed, and the panel doc says what was and was not checked
checks.details: test/client.test.js has 9 tests. Removing the '::' check, the whitespace collapse, the outcome list, the disabled state while a command runs, the active-session condition, or the end confirmation form each turned at least one test red (checked one at a time on a copy, file restored and diffed identical after). The full suite passes: 234 tests, 0 failures, 225 before this change. docs/panel.md has an Actions section with the guards and a Not checked entry stating that the three buttons were not exercised inside DeepSeek Harness (the /awr claim, checkpoint and end commands behind them were checked in DSH under DSH-015).
criteria: The behavior is covered by tests that fail when the checks are removed, and the panel doc says what was and was not checked in DSH.
